name: RA_BILL_PLANS_ALL
description: RA_BILL_PLANS_ALL contains  information about recurring bill plans, including billing frequency, contract dates, and invoice attributes.

columns.name: BILL_PLAN_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the recurring bill plan.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: BILL_PLAN_NAME
columns.description: Name of the bill plan.

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Option that indicates whether the recurring bill plan is active.

columns.name: BATCH_SOURCE_SEQ_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the batch source sequence.

columns.name: CUST_TRX_TYPE_SEQ_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the transaction type sequence.

columns.name: INVOICE_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Code that identifies the transaction currency.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE_TYPE
columns.description: Conversion rate type used for the transaction currency.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Conversion rate used for the transaction currency.

columns.name: PRIMARY_RESOURCE_SALESREP_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the primary salesperson.

columns.name: FIRST_TRANSACTION_DATE
columns.description: Creation date of the first invoice generated by the bill plan.

columns.name: SECOND_TRANSACTION_DATE
columns.description: Creation date of the second invoice generated by the bill plan, when the first invoice was for a partial billing period.

columns.name: PERIODICITY_CODE
columns.description: Frequency with which invoices are generated by the bill plan. Valid values are DAY, WEEK, MONTH, QUARTER, YEAR.

columns.name: CONTRACT_START_DATE
columns.description: Date the contract for the recurring bill plan begins.

columns.name: CONTRACT_END_DATE
columns.description: Date the contract for the recurring bill plan ends.

columns.name: SECOND_BILLING_PRD_START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the billing period of the second invoice generated by the bill plan, when the first invoice was for a partial billing period.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the bill-to customer.

columns.name: BILL_TO_SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the bill-to customer site use.

columns.name: BILL_TO_ADDRESS_ID
columns.description: Identifier fo the bill-to customer site address.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CONTACT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the bill-to customer contact.

columns.name: SHIP_TO_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the ship-to party.

columns.name: SHIP_TO_PARTY_SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the ship-to party site use.

columns.name: SHIP_TO_PARTY_ADDRESS_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the ship-to party address.

columns.name: SHIP_TO_PARTY_CONTACT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the ship-to party contact.

columns.name: TERM_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the bill plan payment terms.

columns.name: RECEIPT_METHOD_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the bill plan payment method.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TRXN_EXTENSION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the transaction created in Oracle Fusion Payments for processing the credit card or bank account payment for the generated invoice.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the bill plan legal entity.

columns.name: GENERATE_BILL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether to print the transaction.

columns.name: FIRST_PTY_REG_ID
columns.description: Tax registration number of the deploying company.

columns.name: DEFAULT_TAXATION_COUNTRY
columns.description: Default country for tax calculation purposes.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_SUB_TYPE
columns.description: Document Fiscal Classification: attribute used in tax determination for transactions that require special documentation to accompany the transaction.

columns.name: SPECIAL_INSTRUCTIONS
columns.description: User-defined instructions that appear on a printed transaction.

columns.name: PURCHASE_ORDER
columns.description: Purchase order number related to the transaction.

columns.name: PURCHASE_ORDER_REVISION
columns.description: Revision to a purchase order number.

columns.name: PURCHASE_ORDER_DATE
columns.description: Date of the purchase order related to the transaction.

columns.name: LAST_TRANSACTION_DATE
columns.description: Parameter of the Generate Recurring Billing Data process that indicates the date of the last transaction generated by the bill plan. Used to determine the start date of new transactions generated by the next process run.

columns.name: LAST_PERIOD_NUMBER
columns.description: Parameter of the Generate Recurring Billing Data process that indicates the last period that transactions were generated by the bill plan. Used to determine the new transactions to generate by the next process run in the next period.

columns.name: WAYBILL_NUMBER
columns.description: Waybill number related to the transaction.
